title: ﻿nP4=14×n−2P3^{n}P_{4} = 14 \times {}^{n-2}P_{3}nP4​=14×n−2P3​﻿ হলে n=?

mcq_questions.description: ﻿nP4=14×n−2P3⇒n(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)=14(n−2)(n−3)(n−4)⇒n(n−1)=14(n−4)⇒n2−15n+56=0⇒n2−8n−7n+56=0⇒n(n−8)−7(n−8)=0⇒(n−8)(n−7)=0∴n=7 অথবা 8^n P_4 = 14 \times ^{n-2} P_3 \\ \Rightarrow n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) = 14(n-2)(n-3)(n-4) \\ \Rightarrow n(n-1) = 14(n-4) \\ \Rightarrow n^2 - 15n + 56 = 0 \\ \Rightarrow n^2 - 8n - 7n + 56 = 0 \\ \Rightarrow n(n-8) - 7(n-8) = 0 \\ \Rightarrow (n-8)(n-7) = 0 \\ \therefore n = 7 \text{ অথবা } 8nP4​=14×n−2P3​⇒n(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)=14(n−2)(n−3)(n−4)⇒n(n−1)=14(n−4)⇒n2−15n+56=0⇒n2−8n−7n+56=0⇒n(n−8)−7(n−8)=0⇒(n−8)(n−7)=0∴n=7 অথবা 8﻿

title: যদি ﻿2nP3=2×nP4{}^{2n}P_{3} = 2 \times {}^{n}P_{4}2nP3​=2×nP4​﻿ হয় তবে n এর মান হবে-

mcq_questions.description: ﻿2nP3=2×nP4⇒(2n)!(2n−3)!=2×n!(n−4)!⇒2n(2n−1)(2n−2)=2×n(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒(2n−1)(2n−2)=(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒2(2n−1)(n−1)=(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒4n−2=n2−5n+6⇒n2−9n+8=0⇒n2−8n−n+8=0⇒n(n−8)−1(n−8)=0⇒(n−1)(n−8)=0∴n=1 বা n=8;{} ^{2n}P_{3}=2\times^{n}P_{4} \Rightarrow\frac{(2n)!}{(2n-3)!}=2\times\frac{n!}{(n-4)!} \\ \Rightarrow 2n(2n-1)(2n-2)=2\times n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) \\ \Rightarrow (2n-1)(2n-2)=(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) \\ \Rightarrow 2(2n-1)(n-1)=(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) \\ \Rightarrow 4n-2=n^{2}-5n+6 \\ \Rightarrow n^{2}-9n+8=0 \\ \Rightarrow n^{2}-8n-n+8=0 \\ \Rightarrow n(n-8)-1(n-8)=0 \\ \Rightarrow (n-1)(n-8)=0 \\ \therefore n=1 \text{ বা } n=8;2nP3​=2×nP4​⇒(2n−3)!(2n)!​=2×(n−4)!n!​⇒2n(2n−1)(2n−2)=2×n(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒(2n−1)(2n−2)=(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒2(2n−1)(n−1)=(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)⇒4n−2=n2−5n+6⇒n2−9n+8=0⇒n2−8n−n+8=0⇒n(n−8)−1(n−8)=0⇒(n−1)(n−8)=0∴n=1 বা n=8;﻿

title: ﻿2nCr=2nCr+2{}^{2n}C_{r} = {}^{2n}C_{r+2}2nCr​=2nCr+2​﻿ হলে 'r' এর মান কত?
